scope: isolated desktop; deterministic 30d focus + 4x posture, no production
sql:
SELECT event_id, data_json, occurred_at_ms, server_received_ms
      FROM device_telemetry_event WHERE sn = ? AND type = 'focus_segment'
      AND json_valid(data_json)
      AND (CASE WHEN json_valid(data_json) THEN json_extract(data_json, '$.end_ms') END) > ? AND (CASE WHEN json_valid(data_json) THEN json_extract(data_json, '$.end_ms') END) < ?
      AND CASE WHEN json_valid(data_json) THEN json_extract(data_json, '$.start_ms') < ? ELSE 0 END
      ORDER BY server_received_ms, rowid
